groups.saying_opens: أشهد على وصيته إسحاق بن جعفر
إن أسفل هذا الكتاب كنز لنا

notes: The will (Musa al-Kazim's testament) is saying 1; the Imam is named inside the chain's words, so he is the last link (owner ruling 2). Saying 2 is Abdullah al-Ja'fari's story of the seal, with al-Abbas speaking. The later speeches of Ali ibn Musa and the Caliph's scene are not separate routes.
